title: PriorArtVerdictEngine
requirements: Implement the P10 verdict stage after real T07 cross-domain evidence and the real T08 skeptic report.
Emit only supported PriorArtVerdict values and never infer PROVEN_NEW from missing matches.
Fail closed on source failures, empty sources and missing provenance; preserve deterministic output.

contract.input: InventionCandidate, non-empty Mapping[str, SourceQueryResult], matching PriorArtSkepticReport and Sequence[PriorArtMatch].
contract.output: PriorArtAssessment with one of UNRESOLVED, PARTIAL_PRIOR_ART or SURVIVED_SEARCH.
contract.ownership: Known/near materiality needs a later explicit contract; P10-T10 owns mutation/re-search.

tests: RED: missing public PriorArtVerdictEngine import -> ImportError.
RED: forged T08 report hid empty source -> incorrect SURVIVED_SEARCH.
RED: public __all__ omitted engine -> assertion failure.
RED: normalized match returned SURVIVED_SEARCH -> assertion failure.
RED: reversed matches changed output order -> assertion failure.
RED: malformed match raised AttributeError -> controlled TypeError required.
RED: match overrode coverage gap -> incorrect PARTIAL_PRIOR_ART.
RED: forged T08 report hid missing provenance -> incorrect SURVIVED_SEARCH.
GREEN: full CRIBA -> 948 passed, 1 Starlette/httpx deprecation warning.

verification.mypy: Success: no issues found in 1 source file
verification.cost: COST=0; no network, paid provider, credential or external write.

limitations: SURVIVED_SEARCH is not novelty, patentability, originality or a claim of exhaustive absence.
The engine deliberately does not auto-emit KNOWN or NEAR_PRIOR_ART because PriorArtMatch has no canonical materiality proof or threshold.
T07/T08/T09 are locally verified but uncommitted because their shared package export and state surface coexist with pre-existing dirty work.
commit_reason: No commit: staging prior_art/__init__.py or shared state would mix P10-T07/T08/P10-T09 and unrelated pre-existing dirty changes.
rollback: Preserve the dirty tree. Revert only verdict.py, test_prior_art_verdict_engine.py, ADR-P10-T09 and this journal; review the one P10-T09 export in prior_art/__init__.py line by line. Never use reset --hard or git clean.
follow_up: Implement P10-T10 mutation/re-search using PriorArtAssessment without reclassifying SURVIVED_SEARCH as PROVEN_NEW.
Run P10-T12 falsification audit against T07 -> T08 -> T09 -> T10 once P10-T10 exists.
